scope: Amazon Reviews matched experiments; model family remains constrained by original prompts
global_budget_change: none; reservation and all failed attempts are charged within the existing cap
local_promotion: compare against current basin incumbent; preserve monotone global validation history
trial_cap: ceil(max(min_trial_seconds + 5, p75(last 32 positive measured trial costs) * 1.25 + 5))
retune_group_size: largest integer 1..4 fitting the chosen jump batch plus four retune groups
acceptance: retune best validation score strictly exceeds pre-jump global incumbent
incomplete_window: restore old incumbent unless already exceeded; no delayed alpha/beta credit
comparison: same data, evaluator, LLM and total GPU budget for jump on/off; exploration trigger is logged explicitly
jump_type: batch of up to four distinct combinations; each modifies 2-4 registered directions spanning at least two parent categories
normal_reward: strict validation improvement over the group-start basin incumbent
category_credit: pair reward only; no component credit
trial_batch: maximize up to four candidates, then retune width within the same protected envelope; only best valid jump enters one basin
hyperparameter_arm: hyperparameter_tuning: joint settings of existing program, no new mechanism
memory: per-candidate concrete proposal, source provenance, input-relative validation delta, execution cost and status; bounded relevant retrieval for hypothesis and implementation
